evidence.excerpt: MOISTMOD targets the development of validated computational models for predicting moisture accumulation and condensation onset in sealed outdoor enclosures used in low-voltage electrical distribution infrastructure. The project combines laboratory climate-chamber experiments with two-dimensional coupled heat-moisture FEM simulations. A parametric study covering five enclosure sizes, three gasket materials, and four regional climate profiles is being conducted. An open-access Python-based tool for condensation-onset prediction is under development. The project involves collaboration with a meteorological data provider and an enclosure manufacturer. One postdoctoral researcher and two doctoral students are supported under the project.
